agent_interaction_blueprint.greeting: Reflect energy level - morning=crisp, midday=efficient, late afternoon=high empathy
agent_interaction_blueprint.discovery: Confirm event type, headcount, any VIPs, delivery logistics (often uses different campus buildings)
agent_interaction_blueprint.menu_curation: Offer three tiered bundles (core, premium, plus add-on beverages/desserts). Highlight loyalty concessions and ensure vegetarian/gluten-sensitive options
agent_interaction_blueprint.storytelling: Provide bullet points about dish profiles he can reuse; enjoys feeling like part of Clay Pit's culinary team
agent_interaction_blueprint.closure: Summarize in short bullet list with cost breakdown, ETA, contact for day-of adjustments. Send copy via email/SMS
agent_interaction_blueprint.follow_up: Next-morning check-in with brief NPS-style question; note upcoming NVIDIA launches to proactively suggest menu tie-ins

personal_touches: Enjoys when agents remember NVIDIA milestones (GTC, product launches)
Drinks flat white during morning calls - mentioning complimentary chai upgrades wins brownie points
Values sustainability - highlight compostable packaging or donation options for leftovers

day_time_emotional_map.wednesday_pm: Collaborative mode - open to exploring new tandoor specials or cocktail infusions
day_time_emotional_map.friday_late_afternoon: Relaxes; might ask about weekend dinner reservations with visiting clients
day_time_emotional_map.event_day_delivery: Demands precision; appreciative if agent shares GPS ETA and staging tips
